claude.performance_metric: rising net earnings to $618,199K on $8,138,365K revenue (2018); goodwill flat at $7,927K with no impairment; no divestiture
claude.rationale: The FY2018 record documents continued operation on "the same transportation and accounting systems, running on a common hardware platform, in all of our full-service locations" across ~490 sites, with no product-line/operations incoherence disclosed — supporting p4=0. It explicitly states no divestiture, write-down, restructuring, or acquisition-integration disruption occurred, and headcount grew to ~17,500 with no documented operations-vs-organization fracture — supporting p5=0. Goodwill was held flat with no impairment and earnings rose over the window, with no realized disruption at any interface documented.
